name: adama
description: Cities seen from space over 40 years, from free satellite data

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.format: prettier --write "web/src/css/*.css" "web/src/ui/**/*.{css,ts,tsx}" "web/src/data/*.ts" web/src/i18n.ts web/src/types.ts web/src/music.ts web/src/pixellogo.ts web/src/loader.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "web/src/css/*.css" "web/src/ui/**/*.{css,ts,tsx}" "web/src/data/*.ts" web/src/i18n.ts web/src/types.ts web/src/music.ts web/src/pixellogo.ts web/src/loader.ts
